versions.changelog:
Initial release of youtube-transcribe skill.

- Automatically transcribes YouTube videos and generates timestamped transcripts and structured summaries.
- Supports language selection (auto/zh/en/ja/ko).
- Simple usage via chat command: `/youtube-transcribe <URL> [language]`.
- Outputs progress updates and clear, formatted transcription results.
- Requires Python 3.8+, yt-dlp, and faster-whisper.
